programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Os Numberblocks são um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vão ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny é uma série baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pré-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: Dinoster: Os Heróis Quânticos

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lemingues
programme.desc: Grizzy senta-se no sofá junto à lareira e os lémingues entram sala no aspirador. O urso faz explodir a lareira.

programme.title: Sericórnio: Chuva de Estrelas
programme.desc: Num mundo mágico subaquático, Astra e as suas amigas embarcam numa ousada missão para resgatar uma criatura com energia criativa, raptada pelo vilão Ika Inkblot, que ambiciona roubar toda a magia dos oceanos. Durante a aventura, as heroínas desvendam os seus poderes, superam obstáculos e compreendem o valor da amizade, coragem e confiança. Com a ajuda de Kameko, uma Sericórnio, unem-se para proteger o reino submarino da escuridão iminente.

programme.title: Luke, o Viajante no Tempo
programme.desc: Luke é um rapaz que viaja para vários mundos e épocas diferentes dentro de um elevador muito especial: um elevador que viaja no tempo! Uma emocionante aventura com Luke está prestes a começar!

programme.title: O Leonel das Moscas
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de Leonel, uma mosca doméstica e filho do meio de muitos irmãos. Lloyd mora com os seus pais, a sua irmãzinha e os seus irmãos larvas dentro de um compostor a que chamam lar.

programme.title: Samuel
programme.desc: Samuel, um rapaz tímido de 10 anos começa a escrever um diário para processar os seus sentimentos, os primeiros amores, as amizades complexas e a transição da escola primária para o início da adolescência. Uma série de animação criada por Emilie Tronche.

programme.title: Dona da Casa
programme.sub-title: Pedro Penim - Diretor Artístico do Teatro Nacional D. Maria II
programme.desc: Ser um homem gay, as decisões de programação, as diferenças culturais no país, o elitismo no teatro, como se mede o sucesso da arte, o processo de gestação de substituição, ser pai, o ódio nas redes, o amor pela cadela.

programme.title: Visita Guiada
programme.desc: Em 1130, Coimbra torna-se o centro da expansão de D. Afonso Henriques contra os muçulmanos. A carência de recursos do Condado Portucalense é colmatada por um casamento estratégico, viabilizando a conquista de Lisboa. A última campanha militar de D. Afonso Henriques, em Badajoz, marca o fim do seu reinado expansionista. Esta é a terceira etapa de uma viagem pela vida do rei, guiada pelo medievalista Luís Carlos Amaral.

programme.title: The Daily Show
programme.desc: A conjugação do humor com as notícias, a sátira política e da indústria dos media no geral, blocos de reportagens, diretos e entrevistas a personalidades políticas ou a celebridades de Hollywood.

programme.title: Jornal 2
programme.desc: O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. A cada dia que passa fazemos leitura do país e do mundo com dados, explicações e interpretações nas mais diversas áreas, como Política, Ciência, Economia e Cultura.

programme.title: Ouro Azul
programme.desc: Em 1988, Alice ponderava deixar Franck por Julien. Em 2026, pétalas de ciclâmen ligam o esqueleto de Alice a crimes atuais. Yacine detém Julien Daumas, regressado à aldeia após 30 anos. Flore, traída por Tristan, concentra-se na investigação e, com Yacine, explora um túnel subterrâneo. Uma explosão ameaça-os enquanto Tristan descobre o corpo de Fanny Daumas, intensificando o mistério que une os dois períodos.

programme.title: O Mistério do Templo da Idade da Pedra
programme.desc: No alto de uma colina da Turquia, encontra-se uma das descobertas arqueológicas mais importantes da nossa época. Gobekli Tepe, o templo mais antigo do mundo, oferece um vislumbre sem precedentes da vida nos primórdios da pré-história. Construído por volta de 9500 a.C., milhares de anos antes de Stonehenge, este sítio monumental desafia tudo o que pensávamos saber sobre as origens da civilização.

programme.title: Ecos da História
programme.sub-title: Mustafa Kemal: Crepúsculo de um Império
programme.desc: No início dos anos 60 com o colapso dos impérios coloniais um pouco por todo o mundo, Portugal de Salazar trava uma guerra sangrenta nos seus territórios africanos. Isolada na cena internacional, a mais antiga ditadura da Europa é a imagem de um país atrasado..

programme.title: The Daily Show
programme.desc: A conjugação do humor com as notícias, a sátira política e da indústria dos media no geral, blocos de reportagens, diretos e entrevistas a personalidades políticas ou a celebridades de Hollywood.

programme.title: Na Sombra
programme.desc: O documentário de Joana X, em formato de diário, segue a criação e lançamento do álbum "Véspera" dos Clã. Desde ensaios e gravações à produção de videoclipes, revela a complexidade do processo de um novo disco de uma das mais relevantes bandas portuguesas. A pandemia, com o seu surgimento inesperado, dá um significado premonitório às letras. Explora-se a cumplicidade do sexteto portuense e a superação dos desafios para levar a música aos fãs.

programme.title: Dona da Casa
programme.sub-title: Pedro Penim - Diretor Artístico do Teatro Nacional D. Maria II
programme.desc: Ser um homem gay, as decisões de programação, as diferenças culturais no país, o elitismo no teatro, como se mede o sucesso da arte, o processo de gestação de substituição, ser pai, o ódio nas redes, o amor pela cadela.

programme.title: Nada Será Como Dante
programme.desc: Filipa Leal e Pedro Lamares iniciam a viagem desta semana com palavras do conto "A Instrumentalina", de Lídia Jorge. Seguimos ao encontro da escritora, nascida no Algarve, por ocasião dos seus 40 anos de vida literária, e de uma cúmplice: Graça Morais.

programme.title: O Mundo nos Açores
programme.desc: Pessoas, com modos de vida diferente, que se apaixonaram pelos Açores e aqui decidiram viver encontrando-se completamente integradas na sociedade Açoriana. É uma comunidade cada vez maior de cidadãos estrangeiros com residência nas diversas ilhas dos Açores, muitos deles criando empresas.

programme.desc: No "Gabinete de Curiosidades" são apresentados vários curiosidades culturais e históricas. De frases intrigantes, à análise de filmes, de pessoas interessantes, a lugares inesperados.

programme.title: E2 - Escola Superior de Comunicação Social
programme.desc: Os acontecimentos trágicos ocorrem de maneira inesperada e dramática. Embora as notícias e reportagens que os retratam devam cumprir critérios que vão ao encontro da ética e deontologia do jornalismo, a forma como a sua cobertura é feita é muitas vezes colocada em causa.

programme.title: Ibéria: Uma Terra de Paixões
programme.desc: O documentário de Eduardo Barrachina desvenda a paixão intrínseca à fauna selvagem ibérica, refletindo a intensidade humana de Espanha. Animais da Península formam casais apaixonados, prontos para combates e a expor-se a predadores em nome da reprodução. Esta paixão estende-se à proteção incondicional da prole, levando-os a sacrificar a própria vida. A Ibéria é uma terra de paixões.

programme.desc: A oceanógrafa Abigail regressa a Fécamp, a pedido do IFREMER, para investigar o naufrágio do barco de arrasto "Rose Davies", com 14 marinheiros a bordo. Enquanto procura os destroços com o agente Prigent, ocorrem incidentes misteriosos no mar.

A fortaleza, o comércio tradicional, a gastronomia ou história são um convite irresistível para começarmos a nossa viagem por Valença.

programme.title: Sopro - A Transformação do Vidro
programme.desc: Martinho Pita é um arquiteto que se dedica atualmente ao design de candeeiros, dando primazia aos processos artesanais e manufaturados. Desde sempre o vidro foi um aliado da iluminação e o propósito de Pita é modelar ambientes e provocar sensações, trabalhando a cor do vidro e colocando em evidência a sua plasticidade. Pita vai até ao CENCAL, Marinha Grande, aproveitar o talento de Arlindo Francisco, formador em vidro soprado.

programme.desc: Um grupo de adolescentes frequenta uma escola especial para futuros super-heróis onde tentam dominar pistas de obstáculos mortais e criar as suas próprias super-roupas!

programme.title: Aconteceu Mesmo!
programme.desc: Todas as semanas uma nova aventura cheia de humor e boa disposição! O Mamadú e a sua companheira Nave, viajam no tempo para desvendar mistérios, esclarecer mitos e lendas e descobrir momentos únicos da História de Portugal. Coisas incríveis que... aconteceram mesmo!

programme.title: Radar XS
programme.desc: Radar XS é um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciência e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.title: Andebol Masculino: EHF Euro Cup - Portugal x Suíça
programme.desc: A Seleção Nacional de Andebol, os "Heróis do Mar", enfrenta a Suíça a 4 de novembro de 2026, na Super Bock Arena, no Porto. Este encontro, inserido na EHF Euro Cup 2026/27 (com Espanha e Dinamarca), é crucial para a preparação do Campeonato da Europa de 2028, que Portugal coorganizará. Após o histórico quinto lugar no Euro 2026, a equipa regressa a casa para um duelo intenso e emocionante, com o apoio dos adeptos, visando futuros desafios internacionais.

programme.title: O Elogio da Luz
programme.sub-title: É Preciso Ver e Amar as Estrelas
programme.desc: A poluição luminosa causa graves problemas nos espaços públicos. O excesso de iluminação artificial dificulta a observação do céu e das estrelas. Para além de ser prejudicial para o ser humano e meio ambiente, reflete-se também em gastos energéticos desnecessários e dispendiosos para os cidadãos.

programme.title: The Daily Show
programme.desc: A conjugação do humor com as notícias, a sátira política e da indústria dos media no geral, blocos de reportagens, diretos e entrevistas a personalidades políticas ou a celebridades de Hollywood.

programme.title: Jornal 2

programme.title: Ouro Azul
programme.desc: Em 1988, Alice grávida parte, deixando um coração partido. Em 2026, a explosão de um túnel desvenda esqueletos e uma aliança "Costa", a mesma encontrada em Alice, ligando o passado ao presente. Com o assassinato de Fanny, a ameaça intensifica-se sobre Franck e Solange, últimos sobreviventes de famílias ligadas à obra do túnel. Enquanto Flore se aproxima de Yacine, ambos ficam preocupados com o desaparecimento de Solange e do pai de Flore, mergulhando-os numa terrível inquietação.

programme.title: Um Mundo Dividido
programme.desc: Em 1942, Khrushchev lidera um contra-ataque em Estalinegrado, enquanto lida com o desaparecimento do filho e protege a neta de Estaline. Na Alemanha, Wernher von Braun, após a destruição de Peenemunde, recorre a mão-de-obra prisional para o seu programa de foguetões. Simultaneamente, Frantz Fanon alista-se nas Forças Francesas Livres, enfrentando racismo e avançando pelo sul de França durante o desembarque na Normandia.

programme.title: A Guerra dos Tronos - A Verdadeira História da Europa
programme.desc: Henrique IV é o novo rei da França. Mas sendo protestante, poucos aceitam vê-lo usar a coroa. Em abril de 1590, o rei e as suas tropas, 21 000 homens, chegam às portas de Paris. A poderosa Liga Católica, que conta com o dobro dos homens, impede-o de entrar na capital para assumir o trono.

programme.title: The Daily Show

programme.desc: A corrida à presidência entra num turbilhão de escândalos e manobras políticas. Confrontado com alegações comprometedoras, Francoeur, que é considerado o favorito, oscila entre a transparência e a dissimulação, abalando a confiança do seu círculo mais próximo. Entretanto, uma reviravolta dramática altera completamente o cenário político...

programme.title: Vencidos

programme.title: Nada Será Como Dante
programme.desc: "Nenhum vivo pode substituir um morto, Nenhum de nós é verdadeiramente vivo nem verdadeiramente morto" - é com as palavras d O Ano da Morte de Ricardo Reis que Filipa Leal e Pedro Lamares dão o mote para um dueto imperdível. João Botelho e Pilar Del Ríosentam-se à conversa.

programme.desc: O plano de assalto à Gulbenkian não corre como esperado, mas os Malandros conseguem ficar com as joias! Só que Silvino, egoísta, fica com elas e desaparece. A quadrilha só o volta a encontrar tempos mais tarde, vestido de polícia. Assim que se apercebem da presença dele, começam a persegui-lo.

programme.title: Teia
programme.desc: A exigência de um espaço próprio é crucial para a criação das novas gerações de artistas. Em Lisboa, Anafaia Supico, artista franco-portuguesa, encontrou numa antiga marcenaria o seu atelier, onde desenvolve tinturaria natural e pintura em tecido, incluindo a técnica "ikat" com Fernanda Fragateiro. Maria Appleton, artista visual, instalou o seu estúdio num armazém no Beato, focando-se na tecelagem, serigrafia e instalações "site specific".

programme.desc: Um programa de conversas em torno do que é a Gastronomia com G maiúsculo, substantivada e rica, mas não apenas sobre a qualidade do prato já terminado e pronto a comer. Em cada programa, o Refeitório de Joana Barrios serve um menu exclusivo, pensado para e por uma pessoa diferente capaz de nos encher o tabuleiro de histórias.

programme.title: Conhece os Lagomorfos?
programme.desc: Os lagomorfos, como coelhos, lebres e pikas, são criaturas engenhosas e resilientes, embora vulneráveis na base da cadeia alimentar. Essenciais para os ecossistemas, destacam-se pela sua notável capacidade de adaptação. Do Ártico, com corpos arredondados e orelhas curtas para resistir ao frio extremo, ao deserto, onde orelhas grandes dissipam calor, e às pikas solitárias que habitam fendas rochosas nas montanhas, demonstram a sua tenacidade e charme em ambientes diversos.

Já em 2026, Yacine e Flore apuram que Solange é a responsável pela explosão no túnel. Flore encontra um caderno que a liga também à morte de Alice e suspeita que Franck raptou Solange em busca de vingança. Com a ajuda de Julien Daumas, Yacine e Flore intervêm a tempo de evitar que Franck cometa um ato irreparável.

programme.title: As Vozes do Sahara: Juntos Contra a Seca
programme.desc: Justine e Thomas, ecoturistas, filmaram uma viagem de bicicleta de Paris a Dakar. O seu documentário explora como as comunidades do Sara enfrentam as alterações climáticas, mostrando soluções locais. Um episódio aborda a luta contra a seca na Tunísia e Argélia, enquanto outro foca a habitação sustentável em Marrocos e no Senegal. Este projeto realça a urgência de mitigar a desertificação através de estratégias locais.

programme.title: Deus e Ciência
programme.desc: A sinopse explora a questão da singularidade da vida na Terra e a sua origem. Enquanto muitos cientistas veem a vida como um acaso sob condições favoráveis, outros defendem que a sua existência e evolução resultam de um programa universal, sugerindo vida extraterrestre. A biologia investiga como as primeiras células se tornaram seres conscientes, confrontando a teoria darwiniana com a ideia de uma evolução dirigida e a inevitabilidade da aparição humana.

programme.title: Casados À Primeira Vista As Intrigas
As Contas De José Gomes Ferreira
Imagens De Marca
programme.desc: V2 – PRÉ ALINHAMENTO ALTERNATIVO – 1 NOVEMBROPrograma: Imagens de Marca - S24Alinhamento nº Emissão de: 1 de novembro Tema: Da mesa para a estrada Gravação de Pivots: Cristina AmaroCoordenador de Emissão: Catarina Ganhão Promos: SINOPSE DA EMISSÃO: Esta é uma emissão que começa à mesa. Com 130 anos de história, a AHRESP continua a dar voz a um dos setores mais relevantes da economia portuguesa. A restauração representa milhares de empresas, gera emprego em todo o território e assume um papel determinante na experiência turística e na valorização da gastronomia nacional. E seguimos caminho com um brinde à competição que colocou Lisboa no centro da sommellerie internacional. Para lá da eleição do melhor profissional, o ASI Contest Best Sommelier of the World 2026 foi também uma oportunidade para promover o vinho português, a gastronomia e a capacidade do país para acolher grandes eventos internacionais.E fala-se em gastronomia e damos destaque a uma iniciativa promovida pelo Continente. Na conferência “Comer Melhor”, no âmbito do Dia Mundial da Alimentação, estiveram reunidos produtores, especialistas, profissionais de saúde e representantes da indústria para refletir sobre os desafios e as oportunidades que estão a transformar o setor alimentar em Portugal. Uma reflexão sobre o papel de toda a cadeia alimentar na construção de novos hábitos e na resposta às exigências de consumidores cada vez mais atentos e informados.Seguimos depois sobre rodas. A Cupra está a crescer em Portugal e quer continuar a acelerar no mercado nacional. Com um ADN onde o design, performance e qualidade se aliam, a marca salta para as pistas de forma a proporcionar uma verdadeira experiência aos clientes e amantes das quatro rodas. E terminamos – ainda - na estrada com a antiga Europ Assistance, que passa agora a chamar-se Redion. Uma nova marca global do Grupo Generali que reúne áreas como assistência, saúde, mobilidade, proteção da casa e da família e benefícios para colaboradores. Em Portugal, mantém os 380 trabalhadores e o legado da operação, mas reforça uma oferta centrada não só na resposta a imprevistos, como também na prevenção e no acompanhamento das pessoas. Fizemos assim uma viagem por marcas, iniciativas e protagonistas que estão a transformar os setores da restauração, da alimentação e da mobilidade em Portugal. Histórias que mostram como a tradição pode caminhar lado a lado com a inovação, sempre com os olhos postos no futuro. Porque, seja à mesa ou na estrada, há sempre novos caminhos para descobrir.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programme.desc: With his secret exposed, Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange to make the world forget. But when the spell goes wrong and unleashes dangerous foes from other worlds, Peter is forced to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

programme.title: Valiant One
programme.desc: Trapped behind enemy lines with no hope of rescue, a reluctant army sergeant must lead his unit to safety while being pursued by North Korean soldiers.

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: During WWII, battle-hardened army sergeant Don 'Wardaddy' Collier leads the crew of a Sherman tank on a mission behind enemy lines. Outnumbered and outgunned, the soldiers face overwhelming odds as they strike at the heart of Nazi Germany.

programme.title: The 355
programme.desc: When a top-secret weapon falls into mercenary hands, a wild card CIA agent joins forces with three international operatives on a lethal mission to retrieve it.

programme.title: Prisoner of War
programme.desc: During WWII, British RAF Wing Commander James Wright is caught and imprisoned in a Japanese internment camp. Wright must not only survive, but also fight in brutal martial arts matches organized by his captors for their entertainment.

programme.title: Catwoman
programme.desc: In Gotham City, a mild-mannered graphic designer stumbles upon a dark secret. Transformed into Catwoman, with the strength, speed and ultra-keen sense of a cat, she becomes a fearless vigilante.

programme.title: The Gunman
programme.desc: After carrying out an assassination in the Democratic of the Congo, an ex-mercenary has a hit placed on him eight years later.

programme.title: Arsenal
programme.desc: Two brothers grow up to be very different people - one a business owner and one a petty mobster. When one brother is kidnapped and held for a ransom, the other must risk everything to save him.

programme.title: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: Cal is a by-the-book police officer and Marine Corps reservist. When his reckless younger brother is arrested, Cal must decide how far he'll go to fight for his family.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: A ruthless former comrade is back and on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross augments the team with new recruits, leading to a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: Homeless and on the run from a military court martial, a damaged ex-special forces soldier seizes an opportunity to assume another man’s identity - transforming into a vigilante in the process.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: With governments and enemies on their trail, Ethan Hunt and the IMF team search for the Entity - a rogue AI that could destroy mankind.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Journalist Eddie Brock develops superhuman strength and power when his body merges with an alien symbiote. Twisted, dark, and fuelled by rage, the creature tries to control the new and dangerous abilities that Eddie finds so intoxicating.

programme.title: RED 2
programme.desc: Retired black-ops CIA agent Frank Moses reunites his unlikely team of elite operatives once again - this time for a globe-trotting mission tracking down a missing portable nuclear device.

programme.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
programme.desc: When a deranged killer also becomes host to an alien symbiote, Eddie Brock and Venom must put aside their differences to stop his reign of terror.

programme.title: The Grey
programme.desc: When their plane crashes in the Alaskan wilderness, John Ottway must lead his team of oil-rig roughnecks through the icy elements as a pack of hungry wolves haunts their every step.

programme.title: American Assassin

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E1
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E2
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E3
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E4
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E5
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E7
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E8
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E9
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.desc: Advertising executive William Weldon (Franchot Tone) narrowly averts career implosion when his clever wife, Margaret (Lucille Ball), helps him save an important advertising account. But tensions run high in the Weldon household after William's fast-talking employer, J.B. Cruikshank (Edward Everett Horton), invites Margaret to work for him too. The cunning couple must compete with each other to write a campaign for Emil Glinka (Mikhail Rasumny) -- a mad scientist with an alarming new product.

programme.title: Gidget Goes to Rome

programme.title: You Were Never Lovelier
programme.desc: Bob Davis (Fred Astaire), an American dancer in Buenos Aires, Argentina, finds himself desperate for work after losing all his money. He takes a gig at a wedding, hoping to impress the bride's father, Eduardo Acuña (Adolphe Menjou), a local club owner who has decreed that his daughters must marry in order of age. Eduardo eventually agrees to allow Bob to perform at his club, but only under the condition that he play suitor to his second-oldest daughter, the beautiful Maria (Rita Hayworth).

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off!

Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith
programme.desc: In 1963, the small Belgian town of Comblain-la-Tour hosted an exciting line-up of both new and older jazz groups. Opening things up is the British trombonist Charlie Galbraith's All Star Jazz Band, performing classic Dixieland jazz. Next up is German singer Knut Kiesewetter, who, with backing from the Prague Dixieland Band, sings the blues. Perhaps the highlight of this event is the coupling of American alto saxophonist Bud Shank with Dutch pianist Pim Jacobs' trio, who play standards and bossa nova. Bringing things to a close are French clarinetist Marc Laferrière and his New Orleans Stompers with more classic Dixieland.

programme.title: Christian Scott
programme.sub-title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah, The Walk
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon, George Gruntz, Guy Pedersen & Daniel Humair
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 & '64 features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others. One of the most influential saxophonists in jazz history, Dexter Gordon is captured in sharp form and style in this 70-minute tour de force.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London's Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect. Bennett is accompanied by his musical director Torrie Zito and an orchestra of British musicians that includes Kenny Clare (drums), Don Lusher (trombone), and Kenny Baker (trumpet). Tune in for Bennett's captivating take on songs “The Good Things in Life”, “My Favorite Things”, “My Love”, “I've Got Five Dollars”, “It Don't Mean a Thing”, and “Maybe This Time” in this magical concert recording.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery, Pim Jacobs, Ruud Jacobs & Han Bennink
programme.sub-title: Guitarlegend Wes Montgomery in The Netherlands
programme.desc: Wes Montgomery: Live in '65 shines a light on one of the most unique and influential guitarists in music history. These beautifully filmed programs from the spring of 1965 feature Wes, in intimate studio settings, leading three different lineups through some of his best-known tunes, including “Four On Six”, “Jingles”, and “West Coast Blues”. This rare footage, featuring rehearsals, between-song banter, and closeup camera angles, illuminates Wes's extraordinary musical vocabulary and unconventional picking technique.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John McLaughlin & Mahavishnu Orchestra
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, the acclaimed jazz fusion group Mahavishnu Orchestra led by guitarist John McLaughlin took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. This third incarnation of the group featured an outstanding lineup, with Jim Beard on keyboards, Jonas Hellborg on bass, Danny Gottlieb on drums, and Bill Evans on saxophone.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Jihye Kim, Johan Karlström & Christine Nonbo Andersen
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2019.

programme.title: Yannick Nézet-Séguin & Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006. For 12 years, he played a leading role in the orchestra's performances, before returning to North America to take on multiple key positions at the Orchestre Métropolitain (Montréal), the Metropolitan Opera, and the Philadelphia Orchestra. Next to having been awarded 8 acclaimed classical prizes, Nézet-Séguin is also an honorary member and guest conductor of the Chamber Orchestra of Europe.

programme.title: Martha Argerich, Iddo Bar-Shai, Maxim Vengerov & Mischa Maisky
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï. They perform with the orchestra Les Siècles under the baton of Romanian-Austrian conductor Ion Marin. The concert opens with Ludwig van Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, with Argerich, Vengerov, and Maisky as soloists. Written in 1803, it is Beethoven's only concerto for more than one solo instrument. This is followed by Camille Saint-Saëns's musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux), featuring Argerich and Bar-Shaï as the pianists. This musical suite from 1886 consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal. The work was published posthumously in 1922, as Saint-Saëns was concerned that his animal miniatures, full of delightful jokes, might damage his reputation as a serious composer. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 4, 2021.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Dvořák and Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Antonín Dvořák's Scherzo Capriccioso in D-flat major, Op. 66, and selections from Act II of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's famous ballet The Nutcracker (1892). Dvořák's Scherzo Capriccioso (1883) reflects a period of personal crisis for the composer. The work betrays ever-changing moods and a constant sense of inner restlessness. In the music of The Nutcracker, Tchaikovsky combined memorable melodies with colorful orchestration, which has enchanted listeners for decades. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on March 18, 2021.

programme.title: Isabelle Faust
programme.sub-title: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). Both works are part of the composer's well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire. In this Chaconne, Bach develops a series of continuous variations from a theme, exploring a complex range of harmonic possibilities. Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach's technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Maya Oganyan, Eduard Topchjan & Armenian Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece's premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No. 8 ‘Pathétique' – this piano concerto is written in the key of C minor, which contributes to the work's stormy character. As an encore, Oganyan performs Der Bote (‘The Messenger') by Ukrainian composer Valentin Silvestrov. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Seal
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Duets II: The Great Performances is a visually stunning video companion to Tony Bennett's history-making #1 album, Duets II. The musical segments are enhanced by insights on the process from Tony and the duet partners, providing an inside look at this landmark album in an unprecedented career.
